thread:
Alice Nguyen: Heads up — OrbitPay is reporting increased tail latency and a few 503s this morning, customer-facing SLA alerts. They see spike starting ~08:12 UTC. Can eng-platform + oncall own triage and give a short mitigation plan? @Matt @Sara @Rohan
Matt Healy: I can take initial oncall triage. Which route/model are they hitting?
Alice Nguyen: route=orbitpay-prod/generate, model=redwood-gpt-2b-q4 (hosted), p50 fine but p95/p99 up ~2x and occasional 503s. Logs in shared dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/orbitpay (read-only)
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — orbitpay-prod/generate exceeding p99 latency SLO (2.1s) — current p99 4.8s — ticket #INC-4982 created
Sara Kim: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) can we temporarily divert orbitpay-prod/generate to the higher-tier dedicated pool? 2) add short 429-backed rate limit to reduce bursts while we investigate. Both low-risk if done for a short window.
Rohan Patel: I can open a routing change PR for diverting to the dedicated pool. Need owner approval on the policy change (autoscale/burst remains off). Will the customer accept a short degrade (throttled 429s) as a workaround?
Alice Nguyen: OrbitPay prefers availability over throughput — they accepted brief throttling if it prevents 503s. Approve moving to dedicated pool for 30m and adding conservative rate limit.
Matt Healy: Runbook step: pin route -> update routing table -> push change -> monitor 10m -> revert if regression. Sara, can you prepare the quick monitoring checks?
Sara Kim: On it. I'll set up a focused grafana panel (p95, p99, 5xx rate, error types) and a log filter for "model=redwood-gpt-2b-q4 AND status>=500". Also create a temporary SLO alert: if p99 > 3s after change -> rollback.
Rohan Patel: PR: https://git.internal/routing/changes/pulls/712 — adds route override to dedicated-pool-3 for orbitpay-prod/generate and a rate-limit of 120rps per customer. Requesting two approvers. @Matt @Alice can you +1?
Matt Healy: Reviewing now. Quick code snippet I ran locally to sanity-check the route:```bash
# simulate routing change query
curl -sS -H "Host: orbitpay.prod" "https://router.internal/_health?route=orbitpay-prod/generate" | jq .
```
Alice Nguyen: +1 from product side. Approved for immediate mitigation. Please notify OrbitPay support once done.
Rohan Patel: Merged and deploying the override now. ETA ~12 minutes. I pushed a canary to 10% first.
oncall-bot: DEPLOYMENT — routing-override/712 started by Rohan Patel — canary 10%
Matt Healy: Monitoring metrics — initial canary looks promising: p99 dropping from 4.8s -> 2.6s, no 5xx in canary. Continue rollout to 50% then 100% if stable.
Rohan Patel: Rolling to 50% now.
Sara Kim: I added the temporary alert: alert if p99 > 3s for 5m -> trigger paging. Also set a dashboard annotation at time of canary start.
Rohan Patel: Rolled to 100% at 08:34 UTC.
noncall-bot: DEPLOYMENT — routing-override/712 completed by Rohan Patel — rollout 100%
Matt Healy: Post-rollout check: p99 at 1.9s now, 5xx rate back to baseline. No regressions in logs.
Alice Nguyen: Thanks team. Can you keep the override for 30m and then revert? Also we need an action item: root cause investigation (why hosted pool spiked).
Sara Kim: Agreed. I'll own the post-mortem with metrics and heatmap of request patterns. Tentative RCA timeline: initial findings in 4 hours, full write-up EOD.
Rohan Patel: I'll create a revert PR scheduled for +30m unless we see any issues. Linking PR: https://git.internal/routing/changes/pulls/713 (revert-schedule).
Matt Healy: Leaving notes for SRE oncall rotation. If anything changes I'll page.
Alice Nguyen: I'll update OrbitPay support and confirm SLA note. Great job moving fast. :tada:
Sara Kim: Adding follow-up items: - investigate client-side spike (same customer id clusters?) - check model-side CPU/kv-cache pressure - review autoscaler settings for hosted pools
Rohan Patel: Done, revert PR scheduled. Will post final confirmation after revert.
Alice Nguyen: Closing loop — OrbitPay support acknowledged the mitigation and will monitor from their side. Keep PM/customer success posted.
Matt Healy: Thanks all. Marking this thread as monitored.
Sara Kim: I'll add the incident link to the post-mortem when created.
Rohan Patel: Revert completed at 09:05 UTC, no regressions. Closing routing-override.
noncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — INC-4982 resolved — mitigation successful, follow-up post-mortem planned
Alice Nguyen: Awesome. Thanks everyone for quick turn.
